gates.name: Test
gates.detail: dotnet test --no-build --configuration Release --verbosity normal: 279 Passed, 36 Failed, 315 Total. Every failure is PostgresContainerFixture's constructor throwing DockerUnavailableException, e.g.: 'Class fixture type SubZeroDev.Platform.Tests.PostgresContainerFixture threw in its constructor ---- DotNet.Testcontainers.Builders.DockerUnavailableException : Docker is either not running or misconfigured. ... Failed to connect to Docker endpoint at unix:///var/run/docker.sock. ... System.Net.Sockets.SocketException : Cannot assign requested address'. No Docker daemon is running in this sandbox (`docker ps` reports no unix socket). Every non-Postgres test passes, including all 20 new S4 AuthorizationTests. GitHub Actions provisions a Docker daemon natively, which is what #195-#198 merged clean against.
